messages:
Alex: Heads-up — nightly shard 42 failing 3 tests in the integ suite against hosted-api: auth handshake timeout, stream disconnect, and toolcall 422 schema mismatch. Anyone else seeing this?
Maya: saw it on my reruns, reproduces locally with same env. Logs show repeated \"401 JWT kid not found\" then toolcall payload missing headers. :confused:
Sam: fyi this pattern crops up on 42 and 43 but only in eu-west-2 staging. Could be a JWKS rotation or proxy caching TTL. Jordan, oncall?
Jordan: I'm on it, pinging infra/idp. Can someone upload the proxy/auth logs? /cc @ci-bot
ci-bot: test-run 3345678901: logs uploaded https://ci.internal/runs/3345678901/logs — shard artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/shards/42/logs.tar.gz
Alex: Quick triage plan: 1) rerun shard 42 on a fresh runner 2) try a bypass with a direct token to isolate proxy vs client. Can someone run: ./scripts/rerun_shard.sh 42 --fresh-run ?
Maya: starting rerun. also adding env AUTH_JWKS_DISABLE_CACHE=1 to see if cache is the culprit.
Sam: while we wait — the toolcall 422 points at missing \"tool_id\" in multipart body. My suspicion: chunked streaming boundary gets altered by proxy and header drops. Repro command I used:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-hosted-api/internal/toolcall -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -F 'file=@sample.json' -v
```
Jordan: rerun triggered on a new runner as job 3345678920. If that goes green it's infra flake; if red we bisect commits. Alex, can you grab failing request payloads from the artifacts?
Alex: uploaded payloads to artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3345678901/payloads.zip — includes raw request bodies and proxied headers.
Maya: rerun in progress, ETA ~6m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: quick thought — we could add a defensive proxy check that refuses requests missing tool_id with a better error to help root cause, but that's more invasive.
Jordan: if rerun fails we'll run a targeted bisect. Also checking jwks endpoint health: https://auth-internal/jwks returns 200 but metadata shows keys rotated ~2m ago. Possible race with cached kid.
ci-bot: rerun job 3345678920 complete: status=red — same 401 then 422 pattern.
Alex: not transient. Maya, can you kick a small bisect across the last 6 commits touching auth/streaming? I can help run. Command I use: ./bin/bisect-ci --range=main~6..main --test=integ/shard42
Maya: starting bisect jobs 3345679001..3345679004 now, will post results as they complete.
Sam: deploying a short-lived logging wrapper around multipart parser to dump raw chunked frames to s3 for 24h — will catch what the proxy sees.
Jordan: oncall is monitoring jwks cache and coordinating with idp. If keys rotated without cache-buster we may need a fallback to accept old kid for a short window.
Maya: bisect halfway: main~4 is green, main~2 is red. narrowing the window.
Alex: good progress — keep updates here. Ping me if you want infra paging escalation. :thumbsup:
